change.title: pr-8
change.description: FIX: proper handling of group memberships
change.author: Régis Hanol

findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is a multiple of limit
findings.body: `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` gives 2 pages for 50 members with limit 50 (and 3 for 100). The pager then shows "1/2" with Next enabled. Clicking Next sets offset to `min(50, 50) = 50` (line 33), and `findMembers` asks for offset 50, which returns an empty member list labelled "2/2". Use `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` instead.

findings.title: Public group members page now silently shows only the first 50 members
findings.body: Before this change, `/groups/:name/members` returned every member of a non-automatic group. The new controller defaults `limit` to 50 (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22), and `findMembers` sends the model's `limit: 50` (discourse/models/group.js:10,27). The public page (`templates/group/members.hbs`) has no pager, so any group with more than 50 members shows a truncated list. Nothing on the page says more members exist. Add next/previous controls to this page too, or don't paginate this caller.

findings.title: remove_member bypasses Group#remove and may leave user_count stale
findings.body: `group.users.delete(user_id)` on the has_many :through removes the join rows with the association's default delete strategy, so GroupUser callbacks don't run. `user_count` is kept up to date by GroupUser's `counter_cache` (app/models/group_user.rb:2), and the existing `Group#remove` (app/models/group.rb:276-278) destroys each GroupUser so the callbacks fire. If the counter isn't decremented, the `(user_count)` label and the pager's page count in the admin UI drift away from the real membership. The spec checks `group.users.count`, not `user_count`, so it wouldn't catch this. Use `group.remove(User.find(user_id))`, or destroy the GroupUser rows, and assert `user_count` in the spec.

findings.title: Add/remove member failures are silent, and the username input is never cleared
findings.body: `addMembers` and `removeMember` (models/group.js:40-60) have no rejection handler. A 422 (automatic group, or `render_json_error` when the save fails) leaves the list unchanged and shows no message. The `usernames` value also stays on the singleton controller after a successful add (see the TODO on line 62), and `setupController` (admin_group_route.js:11-14) never resets it. Moving to another group and clicking Add then adds the same users to that group. Clear `usernames` after success and in `setupController`, and show the error with bootbox, as the `save` action does.

findings.title: remove_member spec uses PUT, but the route is DELETE
findings.body: The route is `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` (config/routes.rb:49), but this test uses `xhr :put, :remove_member`. Controller tests skip verb routing, so the test passes, but it doesn't exercise the request the client actually sends. Use `xhr :delete`.

findings.title: limit/offset are not bounded
findings.body: Any caller who can see the group controls `limit` and `offset`. A negative limit or offset is passed straight to SQL, and Postgres rejects it with a 500. A very large limit serializes the whole group in one request. Clamp both values, for example `limit` to 1..200 and `offset` to at least 0.

contracts.equivalent_path: None; this is the first paginated member list
contracts.before_after: Sets the group's offset, then calls findMembers, which replaces members/user_count/limit/offset from the response meta
contracts.visible_effect: The members list and the currentPage/totalPages label in group.hbs
contracts.failure_mode: Off-by-one in totalPages lets the user reach an empty page; a rejected request leaves the old page in place with no message

contracts.equivalent_path: Group#remove, which destroys GroupUser rows so the counter_cache runs
contracts.before_after: DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members, then findMembers reloads the list
contracts.visible_effect: Member disappears; user_count label may be stale
contracts.failure_mode: No rejection handler, so the failure is silent; group.users.delete may skip the counter cache

contracts.before_after: PUT /admin/groups/:id/members with comma-separated usernames, then reload
contracts.visible_effect: List reloads; the input is not cleared
contracts.failure_mode: 422 or save error is silent; stale usernames carry over to the next group

contracts.action: Public group members page loads members
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous afterModel, which loaded all members
contracts.before_after: Renders immediately, then fills `members` when the ajax call resolves; limited to 50
contracts.failure_mode: Rejection leaves the table empty with no message

summary: The PR swaps bulk username sync for paginated add/remove-member endpoints. Problems found: the pager's totalPages is off by one when user_count is a multiple of limit; the public group members page now silently caps at 50 members and has no pager; remove_member skips Group#remove and so may not update user_count; add/remove failures are silent and the username input carries over to the next group; the remove_member spec uses PUT instead of DELETE; and limit/offset on the members endpoint are not bounded.
